mapper.insert: INSERT INTO unions (id, family_id, partner_a_id, partner_b_id, status, started_at, ended_at, ended_reason) VALUES (#{id}, #{familyId}, #{partnerAId}, #{partnerBId}, #{status}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{endedReason})
mapper.update: UPDATE unions SET status = #{status}, ended_at = #{endedAt}, ended_reason = #{endedReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
